subject: kair_video
note: KAIR VideoRecurrentTrainDataset; recurrent video training loader, unrelated project, own meta-info convention

subject: kair_blindsr
note: KAIR DatasetBlindSR; the BSRGAN degradation pipeline, which composes a randomised operator sequence -- the subject that exercises operator_trace

subject: uformer
note: Uformer DataLoaderTrain; paired pre-rendered restoration loader from an unrelated group, with no BasicSR dependency

subject: mprnet
note: MPRNet DataLoaderTrain (denoising); a second, independent codebase that arrived at the same paired input convention

subject: zerodce
note: Zero-DCE lowlight_loader; zero-reference, so it has NO target at all -- the subject the contract vocabulary may not fit

subject: mmagic
note: MMagic BasicFramesDataset; OpenMMLab, a different ecosystem with its own registry and pipeline. Added to exercise temporal_window outside the audited family on more than one subject

subject: pix2pix_colorization
note: pix2pix ColorizationDataset; the second external subject that MANUFACTURES its input online from the target rather than reading a pre-rendered pair, and the only one outside the BasicSR/KAIR lineages. Also a different task: colourisation

subject: restormer
note: Restormer Dataset_PairedImage; a vendored BasicSR whose package __init__ the repository does not track, so a clean clone imports a different installed basicsr instead

subject: ddcolor_lab
note: DDColor LabDataset; a colourisation loader that manufactures its input from the target and exposes CutMix and FMix as treatment switches it ships turned off

subject: basicsr_reds
note: BasicSR REDSDataset; the most widely reused video training loader in restoration. Included for reach, and as a concordance check against subject 1, which descends from it

subject: diffueraser
note: DiffuEraser TrainDataset; diffusion video inpainting whose mask generator is ProPainter's, copied verbatim, inside a loader of its own that decodes videos and builds the masked input itself

subject: e2fgvi
note: E2FGVI TrainDataset; video inpainting whose window is 5 consecutive local frames plus 3 randomly sampled reference frames, with an online clip mask as its treatment

subject: gfpgan
note: GFPGAN FFHQDegradationDataset; blind face restoration whose loader builds its input online from the target through the paper's degradation model, on the installed basicsr rather than a vendored one

subject: lama
note: LaMa InpaintingTrainDataset (CelebA-HQ data config); an inpainting loader whose treatment is a mask it generates per item from a weighted mixture of mask kinds, not a degradation

subject: propainter
note: ProPainter TrainDataset; video inpainting with an online moving mask, a local-plus-reference window and a full-frame resize

subject: vrt
note: VRT video SR x4 on REDS (6 frames); VRT ships no training loader and trains through KAIR fc1732f4a451 VideoRecurrentTrainDataset under KAIR options/vrt/001 -- the kair_video class under the configuration a published model used
